name: memory_relate
description: Creates or updates a directed graph edge ('source relation_type target') between two distinct entities (auto-creating missing entities in clinical 7-bit ASCII) so system topology is modeled explicitly, preventing undocumented service or repository dependencies.

source.description: Specifies the source entity name (1-200 characters, matched case-insensitively) so the outgoing graph edge originates from a canonical node, preventing dangling edge sources.

target.description: Specifies the target entity name (1-200 characters, distinct from 'source') so the directed graph edge terminates at a valid destination node, preventing self-referential loops.

relation_type.description: Specifies the forward verb in snake_case (such as depends_on, hosted_on, deploys_to, provisions, governs, references, synchronizes_with, stores_data_for, or authenticates_against) so edge semantics stay uniform, preventing inconsistent relation predicates.

weight.description: Specifies the numeric edge strength between 0.0 and 100.0 (1.0 on create, preserved on update when omitted) so relation priority is quantifiable, preventing unweighted edge ambiguity.

metadata.description: Specifies an edge key/value map (up to 4000 serialized characters, merged via RFC 7396 JSON Merge Patch where null deletes a key) so relationship attributes are maintained incrementally, preventing metadata overwrite loss.
